messages:
elaine: Heads up — PR #21234 is blocked by CI. macOS snapshot test `render_inference` failed on retina runs. We need to get this merged before the 3pm release window. Anyone seen this failure before?
ben: looking now. failure looks like a rendering nondet on a border pixel, low signal-to-noise. rerunning targeted shard.
ben: running: `./scripts/ci rerun --pr 21234 --shard macos-retina-1 --targeted`
ci-bot: Queued targeted rerun for PR 21234 (shard: macos-retina-1). Build #7891. ETA ~4m.
jyoti: fyi last week we had something similar from the GPU texture padding change — might be related if this PR touches layout code.
elaine: PR is only touching inference trace logging but could affect timing. agree we should rerun first, avoid snapshot update unless it reproduces consistently.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: macos-retina-1 — PASSED. Other mac shards still running.
ben: macos-retina-2 failed with same diff. attaching small diff: https://internal.ci/diffs/21234/retina-2 (small single-pixel alpha change)
marc: if it's intermittent, we should avoid blind snapshot update. Can one of the reviewers give a quick approve if reruns stabilize? we risk missing the release slot.
jyoti: I can approve if the rerun shows >=2/3 mac shards green. I'll also add a flaky-test ticket to triage nondet render tests.
elaine: sounds good. ben — can you do 1 more targeted rerun across all mac shards and ping when green 2/3? then marc/jyoti will approve.
ben: started: `./scripts/ci rerun --pr 21234 --shard macos-retina-* --tries 2`
ci-bot: Rerun queued for shards: macos-retina-1, macos-retina-2, macos-retina-3 (aggregate build #7893).
ci-bot: Aggregate result: 2/3 mac shards PASSED, macos-retina-2 FAILED (same tiny diff).
marc: given 2/3 green and small nondet, approving so we don't miss release. will note in changelog and create follow-up to fix flake. :thumbsup:
jyoti: approving as well — please file the ticket with logs + diff link.
elaine: thanks — merging now. if post-merge regression appears, we'll revert and do snapshot update with comment.
ben: merged. thanks all. created ticket INT-4821 for flaky render test + attached diffs.
ci-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for main -> staging.
elaine: awesome, closing this thread.
